description_en: Queries the pricing and discount information required to scale out a subscription delivery group to a specified total number of nodes
description_zh: 查询包年包月交付组扩容至指定节点总数所需的价格及优惠信息
name: GetResourceModifyPrice

parameters.help_en:
The product type, which must match the product to which the target delivery group belongs. Valid values:

CloudApp: WUYING Cloud App. Queries the resource scale-out price of a cloud app delivery group.
CloudBrowser: Cloud Browser. Applies only to subscription browser delivery groups that are billed by node.

This operation does not apply to pay-as-you-go or browser groups billed by monthly active user (MAU)
parameters.help_zh:
产品类型，必须与目标交付组所属产品一致。支持以下取值：

`CloudApp`：无影云应用，查询云应用交付组的资源扩容价格。
`CloudBrowser`：云浏览器，仅适用于按节点购买的包年包月浏览器交付组。

本接口不适用于按量付费或按月活跃用户（MAU）计费的浏览器组
parameters.name: product_type

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the delivery group to be scaled out. You can query only one delivery group at a time.

The delivery group must belong to the current account and match ProductType. It must be billed by node on a subscription basis, have a normal order status, and be associated with a resource node pool.

You can obtain the cloud app delivery group ID by calling ListAppInstanceGroup (https://api.aliyun.com/document/appstream-center/2021-09-01/ListAppInstanceGroup). You can call GetAppInstanceGroup (https://api.aliyun.com/document/appstream-center/2021-09-01/GetAppInstanceGroup) to further verify the current configuration
parameters.help_zh:
待扩容的交付组ID，一次仅能查询一个交付组。

该交付组必须属于当前账号，并与 `ProductType` 一致；须按节点购买、采用包年包月付费方式，订单状态正常且已关联资源节点池。

云应用交付组ID可通过 ListAppInstanceGroup (https://api.aliyun.com/document/appstream-center/2021-09-01/ListAppInstanceGroup) 获取；调用 GetAppInstanceGroup (https://api.aliyun.com/document/appstream-center/2021-09-01/GetAppInstanceGroup) 可进一步核对当前配置
parameters.name: app_instance_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The total number of subscription resource nodes after the scale-out. Unit: nodes.

The value must be greater than the current number of purchased nodes in the delivery group and cannot exceed the node quota of the account. This parameter is not the number of added nodes or the number of sessions.

For example, if there is currently 1 node and you want to scale out to 2 nodes, specify 2 to indicate a final total of 2 nodes
parameters.help_zh:
扩容后的包年包月资源节点总数，单位：个。

必须大于该交付组当前已购节点数，且不能超过账号对应的节点配额。 该参数不是新增数量，也不是会话数量。

例如，当前有 1 个节点、希望扩容至 2 个节点时，填写 `2`，表示最终总数为 2 个
parameters.name: amount

schema.description_en: The response information, which includes the request ID and the resource scale-out price
schema.description_zh: 返回信息，包含本次请求标识和资源扩容价格

Data.description_en: The quote for the resource scale-out of the delivery group, which includes the price details and pricing rules
Data.description_zh: 本次交付组资源扩容的报价，包含价格详情和价格计算规则

Price.description_en: The price details of the scale-out. For the currency, see Currency. For the coupon selection status, see Promotions
Price.description_zh: 本次扩容的价格详情。金额币种见 `Currency`，优惠券的选用情况见 `Promotions`

Currency.description_en: The currency code of the price amount. CNY indicates Chinese Yuan. Use this field to interpret the amounts in OriginalPrice, DiscountPrice, and TradePrice
Currency.description_zh: 价格金额的币种代码。`CNY` 表示人民币；请结合本字段理解 `OriginalPrice`、`DiscountPrice` 和 `TradePrice` 的金额

DiscountPrice.description_en:
The discount amount for the scale-out, not the discount percentage.

The final price TradePrice is obtained by subtracting this value from the original price OriginalPrice. For the currency, see Currency
DiscountPrice.description_zh:
本次扩容可折减的优惠金额，不是折扣比例。

原价 `OriginalPrice` 减去本字段，得到优惠后价格 `TradePrice`。金额币种见 `Currency`

OriginalPrice.description_en: The original price of the scale-out, which is the amount before discounts. For the currency, see Currency
OriginalPrice.description_zh: 本次扩容的原价，即优惠前的金额。金额币种见 `Currency`

Promotions.description_en: The list of available coupons returned in the quote. Each item includes the coupon ID, name, description, and selection status
Promotions.description_zh: 本次报价返回的可选优惠券列表。每项包含优惠券标识、名称、描述和是否选用

items.description_en: An available coupon and its selection status in the quote
items.description_zh: 一项可选优惠券及其在本次报价中的选用情况

OptionCode.description_en: The option code of the coupon, which identifies the coupon returned in the quote together with PromotionId
OptionCode.description_zh: 优惠券代号，与 `PromotionId` 一起标识报价返回的优惠券

PromotionDesc.description_en: The description of the coupon, which is used to display information about the discount
PromotionDesc.description_zh: 优惠券的说明文案，用于展示该项优惠的信息

PromotionId.description_en: The ID of the coupon, which is used to identify the coupon returned in the quote
PromotionId.description_zh: 优惠券ID，用于识别本次报价返回的优惠券

PromotionName.description_en: The name of the coupon, which is used to display the available discount in the quote
PromotionName.description_zh: 优惠券名称，用于展示当前报价中的可选优惠

Selected.description_en:
Specifies whether the coupon is selected in the quote. Valid values:

true: Selected. The coupon is applied in the quote.
false: Not selected. The coupon is not applied in the quote
Selected.description_zh:
本次报价是否选用该优惠券。取值：

`true`：已选用，报价中已采用该优惠券。
`false`：未选用，报价中未采用该优惠券

TradePrice.description_en:
The final price of the scale-out after discounts.

Calculation formula: TradePrice = OriginalPrice - DiscountPrice. For the currency, see Currency. This operation returns only a quote and does not execute payment
TradePrice.description_zh:
本次扩容的优惠后价格。

计算关系：`TradePrice = OriginalPrice - DiscountPrice`。金额币种见 `Currency`；本接口仅返回报价，不执行支付

Rules.description_en: The list of pricing rules for the quote, which describes the applicable pricing or discount rules
Rules.description_zh: 本次报价的价格计算规则列表，用于说明适用的价格或优惠规则

Description.description_en: The description of the pricing rule, such as the user discount applicable to the quote
Description.description_zh: 价格计算规则的说明，例如当前报价适用的用户优惠

RuleId.description_en: The ID of the pricing rule, which is used to identify the rule applied in the quote
RuleId.description_zh: 价格计算规则ID，用于识别本次报价采用的规则

RequestId.description_en: The unique ID of the request, which is used to locate and troubleshoot request issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次请求的唯一标识，用于定位和排查请求问题
